caption:
Every part of the Ghost, spinning.

8 shell pieces, each on a spring-loaded pin. 8 tendons meet at the spider ring, and a Bowden cable to a servo winds the spool to pull them all shut. Pan and tilt servos in the base.

About $165 in parts all in. The generator is parametric, so every dimension is a number you can change, and it checks the parts for collisions before it writes the STLs.

Free files, link in bio.
